evidence: Scanning electron microscopy was carried out using a JEOL JSM-7500F system with an acceleration voltage of 3 kV. Energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy was carried out with an X-Max-150 detector from Oxford Instruments using a voltage of 10 kV. Raman spectroscopy was performed with a Renishaw inVia Raman Microscope with a Nd:YAG laser (532 nm wavelength)... X-ray diffraction experiments were carried out with a D8 Advance XRD from Bruker AXS... Thermogravimetric analysis was used to quantify the ratio of molybdenum oxide to carbon in the hybrid electrodes.
